dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid geometric narrowing of the visible 2D silhouette from the mid-section toward a pointed posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Primarily smooth lateral margins with a subtle, asymmetrical convex protrusion on the right lateral edge relative to the longitudinal axis.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity corresponds to a light-grey to bluish-grey tone across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency distribution of diffuse, non-uniform lighter and darker grey pixel clusters across the central dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse and gradual pixel gradients between varying grey-scale pigmented regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Subtle, low-contrast linear pixel groupings visible on the posterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint linear markings located on the posterior third of the dorsal plane, indicative of superficial epidermal abrasions.
